units.source_text: 早课诵经时，在集体诵经的男声中，我经常感受到勃勃的生机。

en.t: During morning sutra chanting, amid the male voices of the collective recitation, I often felt a vigorous vitality.

units.source_text: 一天中以早课的诵经声最激越，它足以把整夜的妄念吹散，

en.t: Of all the sounds in the day, the chanting at morning service was the most intense, powerful enough to blow away a whole night of deluded thoughts,

units.source_text: 仿佛是从声带中迸发出黑色的水花。

en.t: as if black spray were bursting forth from the vocal cords.

units.source_text: 我不知道自己的事究竟如何。

en.t: I did not know what would ultimately become of me.

units.source_text: 虽然不知道，但一想到我的声音也同样可以把男人的污秽撒向四方，

en.t: Though I did not know, when I thought that my own voice too could scatter a man's defilement in all directions,

units.source_text: 这时它竟奇妙地使我增加了勇气。

en.t: at that moment it strangely gave me more courage.
